description: Agent-facing VFX recipe catalog (TICKET-0241/0243). Clone emitters via engine_asset_apply kind=particle; place stylized_flame.prefab.json for the hero look.

recipes.title: Wall torch layers
recipes.summary: Compact upright flame stack for sconces: disc core + molten flame + embers + smoke.
recipes.notes: Torch-scale molten look; mesh uses flame_core_emissive.

recipes.title: Campfire layer stack
recipes.summary: Stylized molten hearth: core + molten flame + sparks + smoke.
recipes.notes: Same stack as stylized_flame hero; bloom softens the core.

recipes.title: Hit spark burst
recipes.summary: Short bright sparks for weapon hits / impacts.
recipes.notes: Low lifetime, high spread, softLight; attach as brief rate pulse.

recipes.title: Dodge dust streak
recipes.summary: Short dusty motion streak at the feet when the player dodges.
recipes.notes: Spawn via ParticleSystem::spawn_burst opposite the dash direction; not a prefab attachment.

recipes.title: Corrupt aura
recipes.summary: Slow violet-green haze for cursed props or blight zones.
recipes.notes: Low lightEmission; pair with emissive_magic materials if needed.

recipes.title: Stylized flame — molten (trio)
recipes.summary: Blobby crossed-billboard flame + sparks + smoke. Hero prefab: assets/prefabs/Scene Assets/stylized_flame.prefab.json
recipes.notes: Matches particle-trio molten look; bloom (0242) softens the core. Mesh uses emissive_magic pulse as blob stand-in until displace master.

recipes.title: Stylized flame — wispy ribbon
recipes.summary: Narrow, high-spread ribbons for wind-blown fire.
recipes.notes: Swap molten emitter on stylized_flame prefab for this look.

recipes.title: Stylized flame — diffuse column
recipes.summary: Tall tight cylinder emission for pillar fire.
recipes.notes: Low spreadAngle + cylinder shapeSize.y for height.
